caption: The drawing features a single, ornate pitcher set against a plain, monochromatic background. The pitcher is highly detailed with a bulbous lower body that narrows into a slender neck and a wide, pointed spout. The handle of the pitcher is elaborate with a curved, decorative design. The pitcher stands on three short legs, each terminating in what appear to be stylized leaf or shell motifs. The shading is done in grayscale, giving the image a sense of depth and form, with the pitcher rendered in soft gradations of gray. The overall composition centers the pitcher within a rectangular frame that is itself positioned at the center of a larger, blank background. The name “Hater Duany” is lightly signed in the lower left corner inside the inner rectangle.
title: Silver Creamer
